title: BitValue Strategy Manifest, schema v1.0
description: JSON Schema for a strategy asset's manifest.yaml — the single source of truth for a strategy: identity (family@version), market/symbol/timeframe, engine/ABI, parameter schema, data requirements, signal contract, risk constraints and admission state. Shared contract between Athena (backtest) and hermes/signal (live signal generation) to avoid backtest/live drift. The authoritative definition is the Athena source under `$comment`; this published schema is synced from it. Note: some manifest rules are cross-field/runtime checks (e.g. warmup_minutes == lookback_bars × timeframe; family/version must match the asset directory; live_allowed requires a protective SL or the named strategy_managed exemption) and are enforced by `athena strategy validate`, not by this structural schema alone.
$comment: Source of truth: github.com/BitValue-Quant/athena internal/manifest/{manifest.go,validate.go}; spec: genie tech-design/athena/strategy-manifest-schema.md. Synced at athena aa65d05.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. This build supports "1.0"; other values are accepted with a warning.

family.description: Strategy family — left half of the family@version locator; must match the asset directory.

version.description: Strategy version — right half of family@version (e.g. "2026q3").

symbol.description: Research/live symbol (a backtest config may override).

kind.description: go = native strategy-lib engine; bsl = goja-interpreted .js (main research path); so/python = frozen legacy stacks.

abi_version.description: qb ABI version; used by the .so path. go/bsl do not need it (a 0/unset value warns).

library.description: .so path; empty for in-process go / bsl.

entrypoint.description: Strategy source relative to the manifest dir. REQUIRED when kind=bsl (the .js run by goja); ignored for go/.so.

tunable.description: If false, excluded from parameter grid / plateau scans.

warmup_minutes.description: Should equal lookback_bars × timeframe (runtime warns otherwise).

state_persist.description: State to persist across restarts (ABI v4).

signal_output.description: Produced-signal contract (cross-checked against the execution layer).

actions.description: strategy-lib signal.Action strings, e.g. ENTER_LONG, CLOSE_LONG, FLIP_TO_LONG.

risk.description: Research/admission risk constraints (not execution config). Hard-checks per hermes AGENTS.md §9.

sl_protection_mode.description: enforced = exchange-side SL required; strategy_managed = named exemption, strategy owns the exit.

has_protective_sl.description: Required true when live_allowed=true, unless sl_protection_mode=strategy_managed (runtime cross-check).

reduce_only_close.description: Must be true — close orders are reduce-only (AGENTS §9).

flip_two_phase.description: Must be true when the strategy emits FLIP actions (runtime cross-check).

live_allowed.description: Default false. When true: requires a protective SL (or strategy_managed exemption) and a reviewer (runtime cross-check).
